item.nusmp.aerie_courier_gloves.card: God Grade. Riding gloves of the sky couriers, whose parcels were never late. The wind takes the wearer's side, and the grip never slips.
item.nusmp.aerie_courier_gloves.desc: Riding gloves of the sky couriers, whose parcels were never late. The wind takes the wearer's side, and the grip never slips.
item.nusmp.anheteps_sunscourge.card:
Legend Grade whip (139 damage, 1.6 attacks a second). Needs attunement.
Passive: 40% more damage in open daylight.
While held: +2 reach, 40% less fire damage, the lent skill heat resistance.
Sun Lash (use; cooldown 14 s, 2% magicules): A lash of burning gold along your sight (12 blocks, through every foe on it).
Scorching Coil (sneak + use; cooldown 70 s, 4% magicules): Golden chains drag the foes within 10 blocks to you, burn them and bind them.
Tensura engravings: swift, elemental boost, enervation.
item.nusmp.anheteps_sunscourge.desc: A flail of golden sun-discs strung on a chain of light, the scourge of the king who ate the sun. It is a lash in daylight and a leash at night. 40% more damage in open daylight. Use: Sun Lash and Scorching Coil.
item.nusmp.archivists_starbound_codex.ca: God Grade. A codex that writes itself under the stars, kept by the many-eyed archivist. Its pages are the sky as it was, and it will tell you where a thing stood.
item.nusmp.archivists_starbound_codex.de: A codex that writes itself under the stars, kept by the many-eyed archivist. Its pages are the sky as it was, and it will tell you where a thing stood.
item.nusmp.ashen_forgeheart.card: Legend Grade. A heart of cooled slag that still beats once a minute, taken from the pedestal of the Last Smith-King's treasury. It remembers the fire it was lit with, and lends it.
item.nusmp.ashen_forgeheart.desc: A heart of cooled slag that still beats once a minute, taken from the pedestal of the Last Smith-King's treasury. It remembers the fire it was lit with, and lends it.
item.nusmp.aurliels_seraph_halberd.card:
God Grade halberd (232.5 damage, 1.1 attacks a second). Needs attunement.
Passive: 60% more damage against the undead, demons and other fiends.
While held: +6 maximum health, 20% less magic damage, the lent skill holy attack resistance.
Seraph's Sweep (use; cooldown 22 s, 4% magicules): A sweep of holy light: every foe in a 170 degree cone within 8.5 blocks takes the blow and glows.
Unfallen Light (sneak + use; cooldown 100 s, 6% magicules): Allies within 11 blocks gain Resistance and Regeneration for 20 seconds; you mend a little.
Tensura engravings: holy weapon, magic protection, restoration.
item.nusmp.aurliels_seraph_halberd.desc: The halberd of the seraph who never fell, white-gold with a pair of wings at the blade. Fiends and the dead cannot stand in its light; friends are lifted by it. 60% more damage against the undead, demons and other fiends. Use: Seraph's Sweep and Unfallen Light.
item.nusmp.basilica_halo.card: God Grade. A ring of unfallen light, worn by no one for a thousand years and cooler than it looks. The dark gives way to it, and the wounded are lifted by it.
item.nusmp.basilica_halo.desc: A ring of unfallen light, worn by no one for a thousand years and cooler than it looks. The dark gives way to it, and the wounded are lifted by it.
item.nusmp.bloodbound_gauntlets.card: God Grade. Iron gauntlets with veins of red, from the arena where every wound was an offering. What the fists draw, they keep; what they keep, they give back.
item.nusmp.bloodbound_gauntlets.desc: Iron gauntlets with veins of red, from the arena where every wound was an offering. What the fists draw, they keep; what they keep, they give back.
item.nusmp.broodqueens_stinger.card:
Legend Grade dagger (130 damage, 2.2 attacks a second). Needs attunement.
Passive: 15% more damage on every blow; poison for 5 seconds on the foe.
While held: +0.2 attack speed, the lent skill poison resistance.
Skitter Strike (use; cooldown 16 s, 2% magicules): Dash 7 blocks through your foes in a flurry of stings; each is poisoned.
Brood Frenzy (sneak + use; cooldown 90 s, 5% magicules): For 20 seconds you are very quick and strong; you mend a little.
Tensura engravings: swift, enervation, severance.
item.nusmp.broodqueens_stinger.desc: The sting of the Hollow Queen, pulled whole from her tail: a curved black chitin blade with a sac of green venom at the hilt. It is never dry. 15% more damage on every blow; poison for 5 seconds on the foe. Use: Skitter Strike and Brood Frenzy.
item.nusmp.chronarchs_pendulum_sabre.car:
God Grade sabre (207.5 damage, 1.8 attacks a second). Needs attunement.
Passive: 20% more damage on every blow (a 25% chance on each blow); slowness for 3 seconds on the foe.
While held: +0.2 attack speed, the lent skill thought acceleration.
Pendulum Sweep (use; cooldown 12 s, 2% magicules): A swinging cut: every foe in a 160 degree cone within 6.5 blocks takes a blow and is slowed.
Arrested Hour (sneak + use; cooldown 90 s, 6% magicules): The hour stops round you: every foe within 8 blocks takes a blow and is almost frozen in place for 6 seconds.
Tensura engravings: swift, magic weapon, enervation.
item.nusmp.chronarchs_pendulum_sabre.des: A brass sabre whose guard is a clock-face and whose edge swings like a pendulum a heartbeat late. A quarter of its blows land an hour after the blow. 20% more damage on every blow (a 25% chance on each blow); slowness for 3 seconds on the foe. Use: Pendulum Sweep and Arrested Hour.
item.nusmp.deepwatch_harpoon.card:
God Grade spear (217.5 damage, 1.3 attacks a second). Needs attunement.
Passive: 50% more damage against a foe in water or rain.
While held: +40% swim speed, the lent skill water breathing.
Harpoon Throw (use; cooldown 20 s, 3% magicules): The harpoon flies 14 blocks along your sight through every foe on it; they are slowed.
Riptide Pull (sneak + use; cooldown 75 s, 5% magicules): A riptide drags the foes within 11 blocks to you, soaks them and binds them.
Tensura engravings: severance, elemental boost, swift.
item.nusmp.deepwatch_harpoon.desc: The harpoon of the observatory's keeper, with a line of brine-silver that never runs out. What it hooks in water it drags to the surface. 50% more damage against a foe in water or rain. Use: Harpoon Throw and Riptide Pull.
item.nusmp.hivemind_carapace_pendant.car: Legend Grade. A pendant of the Hollow Queen's chitin, humming faintly with a voice that is not one voice. Wherever the wearer goes, they are never quite alone.
item.nusmp.hivemind_carapace_pendant.des: A pendant of the Hollow Queen's chitin, humming faintly with a voice that is not one voice. Wherever the wearer goes, they are never quite alone.
item.nusmp.ignareths_forge_hammer.card:
Legend Grade hammer (164 damage, 0.9 attacks a second). Needs attunement.
Passive: 50% more damage against a foe with 100 health or more; sets the foe alight for 4 seconds.
While held: +0.3 knockback resistance, 50% less fire damage, the lent skill flame attack resistance.
Anvil Strike (use; cooldown 22 s, 3% magicules): The hammer comes down: every foe within 5.5 blocks takes fire damage and is thrown back.
Forge Eruption (sneak + use; cooldown 70 s, 5% magicules): A pillar of the forge's fire: foes within 7.5 blocks take fire damage, are slowed and burn for 6 seconds.
Tensura engravings: crushing, elemental boost, sturdy.
item.nusmp.ignareths_forge_hammer.desc: The hammer the Last Smith-King struck his own crown with. The head is black iron that has never cooled; whatever is large enough to be worth hitting, it sets alight. 50% more damage against a foe with 100 health or more; sets the foe alight for 4 seconds. Use: Anvil Strike and Forge Eruption.
item.nusmp.nekrathuls_pact_scythe.card:
Genesis Grade scythe (341 damage, 1.1 attacks a second). Needs attunement.
Passive: 30% more damage on every blow; 6% of the damage comes back to you as life.
While held: +10 maximum health, 50% less darkness elemental damage, the lent skill darkness attack resistance.
Pact-Breaking Reap (use; cooldown 24 s, 4% magicules): A reaping sweep: every foe in a 180 degree cone within 9 blocks takes a great blow and withers.
Soul Tithe (sneak + use; cooldown 90 s, 6% magicules): The tithe is collected: life is drawn out of every foe within 9 blocks and over a third of it comes back to you.
Tensura engravings: soul eater, severance, energy steal.
item.nusmp.nekrathuls_pact_scythe.desc: The scythe that reaped the devil's pacts: every contract it cuts, it keeps. Through the black blade runs the void the Pact-Breaker opened and never closed. 30% more damage on every blow; 6% of the damage comes back to you as life. Use: Pact-Breaking Reap and Soul Tithe.
item.nusmp.orials_starfall_staff.card:
God Grade staff (212.5 damage, 1.4 attacks a second). Needs attunement.
Passive: 50% more damage at night.
While held: +3 luck, 25% less magic damage, the lent skill magic sense.
Starfall (use; cooldown 25 s, 4% magicules): Six stars fall on the nearest foes within 11 blocks; each glows.
Archivist's Brand (sneak + use; cooldown 80 s, 5% magicules): Every foe within 14 blocks is branded with a glowing mark (seen through walls) and weakened.
Tensura engravings: magic weapon, elemental boost, magic interference.
item.nusmp.orials_starfall_staff.desc: The archivist's pointer, a staff topped with a cradled falling star and a ring of small watching eyes. By night it writes the sky on its enemies. 50% more damage at night. Use: Starfall and Archivist's Brand.
item.nusmp.orrery_of_drowned_hours.card: God Grade. A brass orrery of seven drowned planets, from the observatory under the sea. Turned in the hand it shows the hour the tide will turn, and sometimes turns it.
item.nusmp.orrery_of_drowned_hours.desc: A brass orrery of seven drowned planets, from the observatory under the sea. Turned in the hand it shows the hour the tide will turn, and sometimes turns it.
item.nusmp.pactbreaker_shroud.card: God Grade. A cloak of the black between two pacts, from the catacombs where the devils were bargained with. No contract holds on the one who wears it.
item.nusmp.pactbreaker_shroud.desc: A cloak of the black between two pacts, from the catacombs where the devils were bargained with. No contract holds on the one who wears it.
item.nusmp.reflected_kings_mirrorblade.c:
God Grade longsword (215 damage, 1.6 attacks a second). Needs attunement.
Passive: 40% more damage while you are at full health.
While held: +2 armour toughness, 30% less magic damage, the lent skill magic resistance.
Mirror Cut (use; cooldown 18 s, 3% magicules): A ray of reflected light along your sight (10 blocks, through every foe on it).
Hall of Echoes (sneak + use; cooldown 80 s, 5% magicules): Mirrors burst round you: every foe within 8 blocks takes magic damage, is slowed and pushed back.
Tensura engravings: magic interference, magic protection, barrier piercing.
item.nusmp.reflected_kings_mirrorblade.d: A blade of silvered glass in a frame of mirrors. It shows the foe a king that strikes first; the king, wholly whole, strikes hardest. 40% more damage while you are at full health. Use: Mirror Cut and Hall of Echoes.
item.nusmp.reliquary_seedheart.card: Legend Grade. A seed the size of a heart, still warm, from the reliquary where the elves buried their gardeners. Hold it and what was cut grows back.
item.nusmp.reliquary_seedheart.desc: A seed the size of a heart, still warm, from the reliquary where the elves buried their gardeners. Hold it and what was cut grows back.
item.nusmp.rimeheart_greatblade.card:
God Grade greatsword (240 damage, 1 attacks a second). Needs attunement.
Passive: 15% more damage on every blow; slowness for 4 seconds on the foe.
While held: +4 armour, 90% less freezing damage, the lent skill cold resistance.
Glacier Cleave (use; cooldown 24 s, 4% magicules): A frozen sweep: every foe in a 170 degree cone within 8 blocks takes cold damage and is slowed hard.
Heart of Winter (sneak + use; cooldown 80 s, 6% magicules): The cold bursts out of the blade: every foe within 9 blocks takes cold damage, is shoved back and nearly stopped.
Tensura engravings: elemental boost, severance, magicule absorption.
item.nusmp.rimeheart_greatblade.desc: Frozen from the heart of the Archon, a slab of living ice that the cold has not finished shaping. Everything it cuts remembers winter. 15% more damage on every blow; slowness for 4 seconds on the foe. Use: Glacier Cleave and Heart of Winter.
item.nusmp.sanguine_wardens_cleaver.card:
God Grade cleaver (210 damage, 1.1 attacks a second). Needs attunement.
Passive: 60% more damage against a foe under 30% of its health; 7% of the damage comes back to you as life.
While held: +8 maximum health, the lent skill self regeneration.
Butcher's Chop (use; cooldown 26 s, 4% magicules): One great blow at the foe in your sights within 5 blocks; below 35% of its health it takes 2.2 times as much (a boss only 1.5 times).
Blood Rite (sneak + use; cooldown 85 s, 6% magicules): Life is drawn out of every foe within 8 blocks, and two fifths of it comes back to you.
Tensura engravings: severance, energy steal, enervation.
item.nusmp.sanguine_wardens_cleaver.desc: A butcher's cleaver the size of a door, notched with the count of a cult's offerings. Whatever it wounds bleeds into its wielder. 60% more damage against a foe under 30% of its health; 7% of the damage comes back to you as life. Use: Butcher's Chop and Blood Rite.
item.nusmp.silent_winter_mantle.card: God Grade. A mantle of woven hoarfrost from the Archon's cathedral. It is never cold to the one who wears it, and it makes every sound in a room go quiet.
item.nusmp.silent_winter_mantle.desc: A mantle of woven hoarfrost from the Archon's cathedral. It is never cold to the one who wears it, and it makes every sound in a room go quiet.
God Grade. A sash of silvered glass links, from the court of the Reflected King. A blow that reaches the wearer reaches a reflection of them first.
A sash of silvered glass links, from the court of the Reflected King. A blow that reaches the wearer reaches a reflection of them first.
item.nusmp.sun_eaters_locket.card: Legend Grade. A gold locket on a chain of sun-gold, taken from the Sun-Eater's crypt. Inside is a hair-thin line of the light he ate; it is warm, and it is never quite yours.
item.nusmp.sun_eaters_locket.desc: A gold locket on a chain of sun-gold, taken from the Sun-Eater's crypt. Inside is a hair-thin line of the light he ate; it is warm, and it is never quite yours.
item.nusmp.thornmothers_briar_bow.card:
Legend Grade bow (152.5 damage, 1.3 attacks a second). Needs attunement.
Passive: 20% more damage on every blow; poison for 3 seconds on the foe.
While held: +2 luck, the lent skill poison resistance.
Briar Volley (sneak + use; cooldown 28 s, 3% magicules): Four thorn arrows at the nearest foes in front, within 26 blocks; each one slows.
Thorn Snare (the worn-relic key; cooldown 70 s, 4% magicules): Briars drag the foes within 9 blocks to you and bind them with deep slowness.
Tensura engravings: swift, barrier piercing, vitality.
item.nusmp.thornmothers_briar_bow.desc: Grown, not made: a bow of living briar that Yselde wore for a spine. Its arrows leave thorns in what they hit, and the thorns do not stop. 20% more damage on every blow; poison for 3 seconds on the foe. Use: Briar Volley and Thorn Snare.
item.nusmp.valkarins_stormlance.card:
God Grade spear (217.5 damage, 1.2 attacks a second). Needs attunement.
Passive: 60% more damage against a foe in the air.
While held: +5% movement speed, +1 reach, 70% less lightning damage, the lent skill wind attack resistance.
Stormcharge (use; cooldown 20 s, 3% magicules): Dash 11 blocks through your foes at the head of a bolt; each takes lightning damage.
Thunderhead (sneak + use; cooldown 80 s, 6% magicules): Five bolts out of the clear sky on the nearest foes within 10 blocks; each weakens.
Tensura engravings: elemental boost, barrier piercing, swift.
item.nusmp.valkarins_stormlance.desc: A sky-rider's lance with a conical head wound in lightning coils and swept fins. What flies, it brings down; what stands, it charges through. 60% more damage against a foe in the air. Use: Stormcharge and Thunderhead.
item.nusmp.vaultmakers_pocketwatch.card: God Grade. The pocketwatch of the artificer who built the Vault of Hours, running a hand behind the day. Whoever winds it owns a moment nobody else was given.
item.nusmp.vaultmakers_pocketwatch.desc: The pocketwatch of the artificer who built the Vault of Hours, running a hand behind the day. Whoever winds it owns a moment nobody else was given.
message.nusmp.mega.pocket.boss.dead: The master of the tomb falls. The seal still holds the treasury.
message.nusmp.mega.pocket.boss.lost: The master of the tomb is gone. Its treasury is yours to open.
message.nusmp.mega.pocket.collapse.rescu: The floor gives way. The mana of the tomb carries you to the entry hall.
message.nusmp.mega.pocket.collapse.room: This room is about to fall: get out!
message.nusmp.mega.pocket.collapse.start: The primary relic is gone. The tomb is coming down: run for the entry hall!
message.nusmp.mega.pocket.collapse.sub: %s seconds. The deepest rooms fall first.
message.nusmp.mega.pocket.collapse.title: The tomb is collapsing
message.nusmp.mega.pocket.keeper.dead: The keeper falls and drops the Sigil of the seal.
message.nusmp.mega.pocket.resonance: An ancient spell of %s resonates with your %s grimoire and inscribes itself into it.
message.nusmp.mega.pocket.seal.deny: The seal does not answer you. It wants %s magic, the %s, or force.
message.nusmp.mega.pocket.seal.hint: A seal of condensed mana: it answers to %s magic, to the %s, or to force (%s of %s left).
message.nusmp.mega.pocket.sigil.lore2: Press it to the seal. It is spent when the seal opens.
message.nusmp.mega.rift.broadcast: A great rift has torn open on floor %s of the dungeon. Every kingdom will want what is behind it.
message.nusmp.mega.rift.cmd.falling: The tomb in slot %s begins to fall (%s s).
message.nusmp.mega.rift.cmd.fallingAlrea: The tomb in slot %s is already falling or gone.
message.nusmp.mega.rift.cmd.made: Raised the tomb %s and stepped in.
message.nusmp.mega.rift.cmd.nofloor: A shortcut needs a floor of the Mega-Dungeon under you.
message.nusmp.mega.rift.cmd.nomake: The tomb %s could not be raised (you are in a pocket already, no cell is free, or the cap on tombs is reached).
message.nusmp.mega.rift.cmd.nospace: There is no room for a rift three blocks ahead.
message.nusmp.mega.rift.cmd.nosuch: There is no pocket in slot %s.
message.nusmp.mega.rift.cmd.notomb: There is no tomb '%s' (try /multiverse mega rift pocket types).
message.nusmp.mega.rift.cmd.notombslot: There is no tomb in slot %s.
message.nusmp.mega.rift.cmd.openedMega: Opened a MEGA-RARE rift to %s at %s.
message.nusmp.mega.rift.cmd.sealOpened: Opened the seal of the tomb in slot %s.
message.nusmp.mega.rift.cmd.sealWasOpen: The seal of slot %s is open already.
message.nusmp.mega.rift.cmd.status: Rifts: enabled=%s pockets=%s waypoint=%s; open now %s; pockets alive %s; jump %s-%s floors; pocket %s min.
message.nusmp.mega.rift.cmd.statusMega: Mega-rare: enabled=%s one in %s, pity %s to %s, %s tombs loaded, %s of %s tombs standing.
message.nusmp.mega.rift.cmd.tier: %s: pity %s (soft from %s, certain at %s); the next rift near them is mega-rare with chance %s (about one in %s) at floor %s.
message.nusmp.mega.rift.cmd.tomb: slot %s: TOMB %s (floor %s), phase %s, %s inside, %s s left; boss %s, seal %s, relic %s
message.nusmp.mega.rift.cmd.tombRow: %s: %s (%s), %s rooms, boss %s, relics %s, weight %s, from depth %s
message.nusmp.mega.rift.cmd.wp.noback: %s could not be sent to a waypoint.
message.nusmp.mega.rift.cmd.wp.nosave: %s is not standing anywhere a waypoint is kept.
message.nusmp.mega.rift.cmd.wp.show: %s: floor %s (level %s, sector %s) at %s %s %s in %s, saved at tick %s.
message.nusmp.mega.rift.hint.mega: [SYSTEM] A great rift opened %s blocks to the %s. It leads to %s. It will not stay open long.
message.nusmp.mega.rift.opened.mega: The air SCREAMS open nearby: a tomb out of the old world, torn loose from its place.
message.nusmp.mega.rift.tomb.failed: The tear shudders and lets go of you. (The tomb could not be raised; the cause is in the server log.)
message.nusmp.mega.rift.tomb.falling: The tomb behind the tear is coming down. There is nothing to enter.
message.nusmp.mega.rift.tomb.full: The tear will not open: too many tombs stand open at once. Wait for one to fall.
message.nusmp.mega.rift.tomb.lost: The tear flickers: the tomb behind it is lost to time.
message.nusmp.mega.rift.tomb.spent: The tear is spent: the tomb behind it has fallen.
pocket.nusmp.clockwork_vault.boss.death: The Chronarch winds down, and for one breath every clock in the Vault shows the same, true hour.
pocket.nusmp.clockwork_vault.boss.intro: Every clock in the Vault strikes the same second. The Chronarch unwinds from the centre of the hall.
pocket.nusmp.clockwork_vault.lore: Artificers who tried to build a vault that no thief could outwait. They succeeded: the Vault still ticks, and it will wait for you, and wait, and wait.
pocket.nusmp.clockwork_vault.name: Clockwork Vault of Hours
pocket.nusmp.crimson_abattoir.boss.death: Vorgrim laughs once, wetly, and the arena is quiet.
pocket.nusmp.crimson_abattoir.boss.intro: The red rivers slow on the ceiling. Vorgrim steps out of the shadow behind the dais, already smiling.
pocket.nusmp.crimson_abattoir.lore: A cult's arena where every wound was an offering. The rivers on its ceilings are not water, and the floors remember every one who bled on them.
pocket.nusmp.crimson_abattoir.name: Crimson Abattoir
pocket.nusmp.drowned_observatory.boss.de: The tide pulls back from the Leviathan and does not return.
pocket.nusmp.drowned_observatory.boss.in: Every river on the ceiling turns once, as if the sea were looking down. The Leviathan unfolds out of the dark water.
pocket.nusmp.drowned_observatory.lore: Astronomers read the stars through the sea until the sea rose to read them back. Rivers run along the ceilings of its halls, as if the tide had forgotten which way is down.
pocket.nusmp.drowned_observatory.name: Drowned Observatory
pocket.nusmp.ember_sanctum.boss.death: The furnace-light goes out of the Smith-King's eyes.
pocket.nusmp.ember_sanctum.boss.intro: The anvils fall silent. Something vast stands up from the forge.
pocket.nusmp.ember_sanctum.lore: A smith-kingdom that fed its furnaces with its own sun-stone, buried with its king still at the anvil. The air tastes of cold iron and old coals.
pocket.nusmp.ember_sanctum.name: Sanctum of the Ashen Forge
pocket.nusmp.frozen_cathedral.boss.death: The Archon's heart, a lump of blue ice, cracks and runs like water.
pocket.nusmp.frozen_cathedral.boss.intro: The frozen bells ring once. The Archon rises from the choir stalls with a sound like ice splitting.
pocket.nusmp.frozen_cathedral.lore: A choir sang the winter in and never sang it out. The nave is still full of kneeling frost, and the bells hang, frozen mid-note, over a vault no thaw has touched.
pocket.nusmp.frozen_cathedral.name: Cathedral of the Silent Winter
pocket.nusmp.gilded_crypt.boss.death: Anhetep's mouth opens one last time, and the sun he swallowed comes out of it, and goes.
pocket.nusmp.gilded_crypt.boss.intro: The gold in the walls dims, all at once. Something very old unwraps itself on the dais.
pocket.nusmp.gilded_crypt.lore: A desert dynasty swallowed the sun to keep its dead from rotting, and was in turn swallowed by the dunes. The gold is all still here. So is the patience of whatever swallowed the sun.
pocket.nusmp.gilded_crypt.name: Gilded Crypt of the Sun-Eater
pocket.nusmp.mirrored_halls.boss.death: The mirrors go dark one by one. The last one shows only you.
pocket.nusmp.mirrored_halls.boss.intro: A hundred mirrors show a hundred kings. One of them is not a reflection, and he is looking at you.
pocket.nusmp.mirrored_halls.lore: A court that ruled by showing every visitor a better version of themselves, until no one could tell the visitors from the reflections. The King is whichever one is not you.
pocket.nusmp.mirrored_halls.name: Halls of the Reflected King
pocket.nusmp.radiant_basilica.boss.death: Auriel bows her head, and the light she wore settles on the floor like snow.
pocket.nusmp.radiant_basilica.boss.intro: Every lamp in the Basilica burns white at once. Auriel looks at you with eyes that have never closed, and does not yet decide.
pocket.nusmp.radiant_basilica.lore: A basilica that kept its lamps lit for a thousand years after its congregation was gone. Its seraph never fell, and has been waiting ever since for someone to be worthy of the vault.
pocket.nusmp.radiant_basilica.name: Radiant Basilica of the Unfallen
pocket.nusmp.starfall_archive.boss.death: The eyes of the Archivist close, one after another, and the last page is written.
pocket.nusmp.starfall_archive.boss.intro: Every book in the Archive turns its pages at once. Oriel opens, one eye after another, to read you.
pocket.nusmp.starfall_archive.lore: A library built where a star fell, by scribes who copied the star's light onto paper until the paper burned. Gravity is a suggestion here; the books float, and so do you.
pocket.nusmp.starfall_archive.name: Starfall Archive
pocket.nusmp.stormspire_aerie.boss.death: The storm leaves Valkarin all at once, and the spire is very quiet.
pocket.nusmp.stormspire_aerie.boss.intro: Lightning walks along the spire. Valkarin lowers himself from the roof of the world.
pocket.nusmp.stormspire_aerie.lore: The sky riders built their roost on a spire of stone that no longer remembers the ground. Their halls have forgotten weight; their guardians have not forgotten their lances.
pocket.nusmp.stormspire_aerie.name: Stormspire Aerie
pocket.nusmp.umbral_catacombs.boss.death: The pact tears itself in two, and Nekrathul is the thing between the halves.
pocket.nusmp.umbral_catacombs.boss.intro: The floor and the ceiling trade places in your mind. A voice that has not spoken in a thousand years says: another contract.
pocket.nusmp.umbral_catacombs.lore: A house that bargained with a devil and kept the bargain too well. Its catacombs run upside down in places, because the devil asked for a floor and was given a ceiling.
pocket.nusmp.umbral_catacombs.name: Umbral Catacombs of the Pact
pocket.nusmp.venom_hive.boss: Vess, Queen of the Hollow Hive
pocket.nusmp.venom_hive.boss.death: The hum goes out of the hive, a note at a time, until there is only silence.
pocket.nusmp.venom_hive.boss.intro: The hive stops humming. Something very large shifts in the wax, and many small things turn to face you.
pocket.nusmp.venom_hive.lore: An empire of insects that outlived its builders and its own queen's patience. The hive's rivers are sweet and wrong, its floors are wax, and it is always, always listening.
pocket.nusmp.venom_hive.name: Venom Hive of the Hollow Queen
pocket.nusmp.verdant_reliquary.boss.deat: The Thornmother's leaves fall, one by one, and do not grow back.
pocket.nusmp.verdant_reliquary.boss.intr: The roots of the reliquary draw tight. A voice like creaking timber says: you may take nothing.
pocket.nusmp.verdant_reliquary.lore: The elves who raised this house of relics let the forest grow over them rather than leave. Roots have become its corridors, and the garden still guards what the gardeners buried.
pocket.nusmp.verdant_reliquary.name: Verdant Reliquary
